card.summary: 'kuasoso.com网盘资源无偿分享' - free, no account. The landing page lists the newest indexed shares per pan, tagged 夸克网盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 百度网盘.

free_tier.stated: 'kuasoso.com网盘资源无偿分享' - free, no account. The landing page lists the newest indexed shares per pan, tagged 夸克网盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 百度网盘.

retention.stated: Index lifetime not published; the '最新入库' list is the only freshness signal.

egress.terms: No traffic of its own; the pan behind each link holds the bytes and its terms apply.

record.interface_detail: HTTP GET on /doc/<id> per share and a search endpoint; HTML only.
record.chaining: Same role as 盘行: a source of share links whose value depends entirely on whether the pan behind them can be opened.

identity_cost.detail: No login for reading the index.

record.reliability_note: The 最新入库 list shows 夸克 and 迅雷 dominating and 百度 present, which is the current share-host mix in one picture.
record.confidence_note: Landing page read. No search run.

evidence.proved: 'kuasoso.com网盘资源无偿分享，坚持做最好网盘搜索'; 最新入库 rows tagged [夸克网盘], [迅雷云盘], [百度网盘] with /doc/<id> links

record.notes: Included because the index composition is itself a finding: 夸克 and 迅雷 shares outnumber 百度 in the newest rows, which matches 夸克 displacing 百度 as the default share host.
